focus.title: 美国财政部更新涉俄制裁清单，新增多家中国实体及个人
focus.summary: 美国财政部海外资产控制办公室于7月24日更新特别指定国民清单，新增十余家中国实体及个人，理由为涉嫌参与向俄罗斯出口受控电子元件及无人机零部件。企业应紧急排查交易对手方是否在列，评估存量订单风险，并更新合规筛查清单。
focus.title_en: U.S. Treasury Updates Russia-Related Sanctions List, Adds Multiple Chinese Entities and Individuals
focus.summary_en: On July 24, OFAC updated the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, adding over ten Chinese entities and individuals for allegedly exporting controlled electronics and drone components to Russia. Companies should urgently screen counterparties, assess risks of existing orders, and update compliance screening lists.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心就中企与东南亚买方口罩货款纠纷裁定：不可抗力不当然免责
case.summary: SIAC近期裁决一起中国口罩出口商诉东南亚买方拒收案。买方以本国疫情政策变化主张不可抗力，仲裁庭认为买方未能证明履约障碍与政策变化的直接因果关系，且未及时通知，裁定买方支付货款及利息。提示企业主张不可抗力需严格举证并履行通知义务。
case.title_en: SIAC Rules in Mask Payment Dispute: Force Majeure Not Automatic Exemption
case.summary_en: In a recent SIAC award, a Chinese mask exporter sued a Southeast Asian buyer for refusal. The buyer claimed force majeure due to domestic policy changes. The tribunal found no direct causation and lack of timely notice, ordering the buyer to pay the price plus interest. Companies must strictly prove causation and give prompt notice when invoking force majeure.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区涉外法律服务中心在深圳前海启用，提供一站式跨境争议解决服务
policy.summary: 该中心于7月26日正式启用，整合仲裁、调解、公证及域外法查明功能，旨在降低企业跨境纠纷解决成本。中心首批入驻包括香港国际仲裁中心、深圳国际仲裁院等机构，并开通中英葡三语线上咨询平台。
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Foreign-Related Legal Service Center Opens in Qianhai, Offering One-Stop Cross-Border Dispute Resolution
policy.summary_en: Launched on July 26, the center integrates arbitration, mediation, notarization, and foreign law ascertainment to reduce costs for cross-border disputes. Initial occupants include HKIAC and SCIA, with a trilingual (Chinese, English, Portuguese) online consultation platform now active.
policy.source_en: Source: Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Justice · 2026.07.27

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期应尽快建立内部数据采集体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：CBAM过渡期至2026年底，但中国出口企业普遍缺乏产品级碳排放数据。建议立即建立内部碳核算团队，或委托第三方进行产品碳足迹预评估，并关注欧盟委员会预计2026年第四季度发布的默认值调整细则，以降低2027年正式实施后的合规成本。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: EU CBAM Transition Period Calls for Urgent Internal Data Collection Systems
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The CBAM transitional period ends in 2026, but most Chinese exporters lack product-level carbon emission data. Companies should immediately set up internal carbon accounting teams or engage third parties for pre-assessment of product carbon footprints, and monitor the EC's expected Q4 2026 adjustment of default values to reduce compliance costs after full implementation in 2027.
